edits.old: Then no name, address, contact value or identity number is written to the decision record, a log or a workflow input
edits.new:
Then no name, address, contact value or identity number is written to the decision record, a log or a workflow input

  Scenario: AC13 Error answers of the route operation (section 12.2)
    Given the route command for the case "RC-2026-000410" is sent without a valid credential, without the right or for a case out of scope
    When the route operation answers
    Then the answer carries 401, 403 or 404 in the platform envelope
    Then nothing is written

  Scenario: AC14 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key (section 5, X8)
    Given the hold for the case "RC-2026-000410" has been answered with an Idempotency-Key
    When the same hold is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the stored answer is returned and no second record or move is made

  Scenario: AC15 Activity retried or timed out (section 12.5)
    Given the holdRouteDecision or recordHold activity is retried or times out before its answer is returned
    When the workflow runs the retry on its own schedule
    Then the record is written at most once under the Idempotency-Key and no second move is made

  Scenario: AC16 Consumed call fails or does not answer (section 5, X7)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock fails the call or does not answer
    When the caller submits the hold for the case "RC-2026-000410"
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule
    Then nothing is written and the caller sees 503 in the platform envelope
